question: interior-finishes-to-schedule
unit: sum (whole finishes-schedule package, one 800 m2 NLA tenancy floor, exclusive of GST, preliminaries, margin and design/consent fees)

band.unit: sum (whole finishes-schedule package, one 800 m2 NLA tenancy floor, exclusive of GST, preliminaries, margin and design/consent fees)
band.basis: Built from cited QV CostBuilder rows (Auckland centre rates, all unreviewed) plus two labelled allowances and one web-fetched NZD band for vinyl installation. COMPONENT SUM, no double counting: carpet tile $64,000-$73,000; latex smoothing compound $21,900-$36,500; vinyl wall covering $15,840-$20,900; batten wall on painted MDF $10,800-$15,360; MDF skirting painted $9,880-$10,660; feature paint $7,412-$8,704; LVT $5,400-$8,100; protection $1,800-$3,000; waste/skip $1,800-$3,000; set-out allowance $1,200-$2,500; out-of-hours allowance $4,000-$9,000; trims $729-$914. Midpoint approx $168,200 = approx $210/m2 over the 800 m2 NLA. Allowances carry only about 5% of the total, so confidence is not reduced for allowance content; it is held at medium because four items rest on proxies (Type II 20 oz wall vinyl from a 440gsm row, LVT plank from a glue-down tile row, 42x19 batten from a 40x18 trim row, 100x18 MDF skirting from 85 and 135mm moulded rows), because the carpet tile row does not state g/m2 or EN 1307 class, and because the latex smoothing compound rate used is materially above the schedule's own $22/m2. The build-up independently reproduces the schedule's own rates closely on four of six finish lines (skirting $38-$41 vs $42; batten wall $547 vs $560; carpet tile $100-$114 vs $105; vinyl wall covering $72-$95 vs $88), which is the main reason confidence is not lower. All amounts GST exclusive, NZD, Auckland centre. This is a cost-plan band, not a certified price or a tender.

band.unit: sum, excl GST, whole six-finish schedule package on one 800 m2 NLA Auckland tenancy floor
band.basis: Sum of eleven distinct components at QV CostBuilder Auckland rates (carpet tile 640 m2 @ $100-114/m2 = $64,000-72,960 is the largest; latex smoothing compound 730 m2 @ $33.80-50/m2 = $24,674-36,500 is second), plus one web-sourced LVT rate ($95-160/m2) and four package allowances (trims/sundries, protection+waste+disposal, site measure/setout, out-of-hours loading) totalling $11,200-27,000, i.e. about 11% of the midpoint — under the one-third limit, so the band is driven by published rates. Midpoint $172,000 = $215/m2 over 800 m2 NLA; low $181/m2, high $249/m2. Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design and consent fees, base-build linings/stopping to L4, ceilings, joinery, removal of existing finishes and any levelling beyond a latex skim. Widest risks: the 60 mm-centre batten density (QV has no analogue) and the out-of-hours loading (allowance only).

band.unit: sum (whole finishes-schedule package, one 800 m2 tenancy floor)
band.basis: QV CostBuilder rows (Auckland, GST excl.) for all six finishes plus floor preparation, with labelled allowances of ~$20,700 at midpoint (~12% of total) for substrate prep, batten lacquer, skirting painting, trims/protection/waste and setout/out-of-hours loading. Main drivers are QV-sourced: carpet tile 640 m2 at $100-$114/m2 and latex smoothing compound 730 m2 at $33.8-$50/m2 together are ~59% of the midpoint. Two proxies carry stated adjustments - LVT plank (no QV plank row; 2.5 mm flexible-vinyl-tile row widened by a fetched NZ distributor installed range) and the batten layer (QV lineal batten rate x 16.7 lm/m2 at 60 mm centres). Midpoint $167,400 = $209/m2 over 800 m2 NLA.
